Title: Diabetes Type 2
Description: Type 2 diabetes is a chronic condition that affects how the body metabolizes glucose. It often requires lifestyle changes, medication, and monitoring to manage blood sugar levels.
related_diseases: May be associated with obesity, hypertension, and heart disease.

Title: Hypertension
Description: Hypertension, or high blood pressure, is a condition where the force of blood against artery walls is consistently too high. It increases the risk of heart attack, stroke, and kidney disease.
related_diseases: May be associated with heart disease, diabetes, and kidney disease.

Title: Heart Disease
Description: Heart disease encompasses a range of conditions affecting the heart, including coronary artery disease and heart failure. Treatment focuses on lifestyle modification, medication, and sometimes surgical intervention.
related_diseases: May be associated with hypertension, hyperlipidemia, and diabetes.

Title: Kidney Disease
Description: Kidney disease refers to the gradual loss of kidney function over time. Management includes controlling underlying conditions, diet modifications, and sometimes dialysis or transplantation.
related_diseases: May be associated with diabetes, hypertension, and heart disease.

Title: Osteoporosis
Description: Osteoporosis is a condition characterized by weakened bones that are more prone to fractures. Prevention and treatment focus on diet, exercise, and medications that strengthen bone density.
related_diseases: May be associated with vitamin D deficiency, menopause, and calcium deficiency.

Title: Iron Deficiency Anemia
Description: Iron deficiency anemia occurs when the body lacks enough iron to produce adequate hemoglobin. Symptoms include fatigue, weakness, and pale skin, and treatment involves iron supplementation and dietary changes.
related_diseases: May be associated with chronic blood loss, pregnancy, and gastrointestinal disorders.

Title: Celiac Disease
Description: Celiac disease is an autoimmune disorder where ingestion of gluten damages the small intestine. Management requires a strict gluten-free diet to prevent symptoms and complications.
related_diseases: May be associated with type 1 diabetes, thyroid disorders, and anemia.

Title: Inflammatory Bowel Disease
Description: Inflammatory bowel disease (IBD) includes chronic conditions like Crohn's disease and ulcerative colitis, causing inflammation of the digestive tract. Treatment involves medication, diet management, and sometimes surgery.
related_diseases: May be associated with arthritis, skin disorders, and malnutrition.

Title: Liver Disease
Description: Liver disease encompasses conditions that impair liver function, such as hepatitis, fatty liver, and cirrhosis. Management focuses on treating the underlying cause and lifestyle modifications to reduce liver strain.
related_diseases: May be associated with obesity, diabetes, and alcohol use.

Title: Thyroid Disorders
Description: Thyroid disorders occur when the thyroid gland produces too much or too little hormone, affecting metabolism and energy levels. Treatment may involve hormone replacement, medication, or surgery depending on the type.
related_diseases: May be associated with autoimmune disorders, heart disease, and depression.

Title: Type 1 Diabetes
Description: Type 1 diabetes is an autoimmune condition where the body attacks insulin-producing cells in the pancreas. Management requires insulin therapy, blood sugar monitoring, and lifestyle adjustments.
related_diseases: May be associated with thyroid disorders, celiac disease, and heart disease.

Title: Obesity
Description: Obesity is a condition characterized by excessive body fat that increases the risk of health problems. Management includes diet, physical activity, behavioral changes, and sometimes medication or surgery.
related_diseases: May be associated with type 2 diabetes, hypertension, and heart disease.

Title: Chronic Kidney Disease Stage 3
Description: Stage 3 chronic kidney disease indicates moderate kidney damage with a decreased ability to filter waste. Management focuses on controlling underlying conditions, diet, and monitoring kidney function.
related_diseases: May be associated with hypertension, diabetes, and cardiovascular disease.

Title: Chronic Kidney Disease Stage 4
Description: Stage 4 chronic kidney disease represents severe kidney damage with a significant reduction in kidney function. Treatment may include dietary restrictions, medications, and preparation for dialysis or transplant.
related_diseases: May be associated with hypertension, diabetes, and heart disease.

Title: Chronic Kidney Disease Stage 5
Description: Stage 5 chronic kidney disease is kidney failure where the kidneys function at less than 15% capacity. Management includes dialysis, kidney transplantation, and strict control of contributing conditions.
related_diseases: May be associated with hypertension, diabetes, and cardiovascular complications.

Title: Polycystic Ovary Syndrome
Description: Polycystic ovary syndrome (PCOS) is a hormonal disorder causing irregular periods, ovarian cysts, and metabolic issues. Treatment may include lifestyle changes, medication for hormone regulation, and fertility management.
related_diseases: May be associated with insulin resistance, obesity, and type 2 diabetes.

Title: Gestational Diabetes
Description: Gestational diabetes develops during pregnancy and affects how the body processes sugar. Management includes blood sugar monitoring, diet, and sometimes insulin therapy to protect maternal and fetal health.
related_diseases: May be associated with obesity, type 2 diabetes, and hypertension.

Title: PCOS with Insulin Resistance
Description: PCOS with insulin resistance combines hormonal imbalance with reduced insulin sensitivity. Management focuses on lifestyle changes, medications to improve insulin sensitivity, and hormone regulation.
related_diseases: May be associated with obesity, type 2 diabetes, and metabolic syndrome.

Title: Metabolic Syndrome
Description: Metabolic syndrome is a cluster of conditions including high blood pressure, high blood sugar, excess abdominal fat, and abnormal cholesterol levels. Management focuses on lifestyle modifications and treating each component condition.
related_diseases: May be associated with obesity, type 2 diabetes, and heart disease.

Title: Hyperlipidemia
Description: Hyperlipidemia is a condition characterized by elevated levels of lipids in the blood, increasing cardiovascular risk. Management includes diet, exercise, and sometimes lipid-lowering medications.
related_diseases: May be associated with heart disease, obesity, and diabetes.

Title: Gout
Description: Gout is a form of inflammatory arthritis caused by excess uric acid forming crystals in the joints. Management includes diet changes, medications to lower uric acid, and lifestyle modifications.
related_diseases: May be associated with obesity, hypertension, and kidney disease.

Title: Gluten Intolerance
Description: Gluten intolerance causes digestive symptoms after consuming gluten without the autoimmune response seen in celiac disease. Management involves a gluten-free diet to reduce discomfort and prevent complications.
related_diseases: May be associated with irritable bowel syndrome, fatigue, and nutrient deficiencies.

Title: Ulcerative Colitis (Remission)
Description: Ulcerative colitis in remission is when inflammation of the colon is minimal or absent, and symptoms are controlled. Maintenance therapy and diet management are important to prevent flare-ups.
related_diseases: May be associated with arthritis, skin disorders, and anemia.

Title: Ulcerative Colitis (Active)
Description: Active ulcerative colitis involves ongoing inflammation of the colon with symptoms such as diarrhea, bleeding, and abdominal pain. Treatment includes medications, dietary adjustments, and sometimes surgery.
related_diseases: May be associated with arthritis, malnutrition, and liver disorders.

Title: COPD
Description: Chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD) is a progressive lung condition that causes airflow obstruction and breathing difficulties. Management includes medications, pulmonary rehabilitation, and lifestyle changes such as smoking cessation.
related_diseases: May be associated with chronic bronchitis, emphysema, and cardiovascular disease.

Title: Asthma (Active)
Description: Active asthma is a condition where the airways are inflamed and constricted, causing wheezing, coughing, and shortness of breath. Management includes inhalers, medications, and avoiding triggers.
related_diseases: May be associated with allergies, eczema, and respiratory infections.

Title: Anxiety (Nutrition Focused)
Description: Nutrition-focused anxiety management explores how diet and nutrient intake influence anxiety symptoms. Strategies may include maintaining stable blood sugar, avoiding stimulants, and supporting gut health.
related_diseases: May be associated with depression, sleep disorders, and digestive issues.

Title: Depression (Nutrition Focused)
Description: Nutrition-focused depression management considers dietary patterns and nutrient deficiencies that can impact mood. Interventions include balanced meals, omega-3 fatty acids, and micronutrient support.
related_diseases: May be associated with anxiety, obesity, and cardiovascular disease.

Title: Alzheimer’s Disease (Early)
Description: Early-stage Alzheimer’s disease involves mild memory loss and cognitive decline that gradually progresses. Management focuses on cognitive support, lifestyle interventions, and medications to slow progression.
related_diseases: May be associated with cardiovascular disease, diabetes, and depression.

Title: Parkinson’s Disease
Description: Parkinson’s disease is a progressive neurological disorder that affects movement, causing tremors, stiffness, and slowed coordination. Management includes medications, physical therapy, and lifestyle adaptations to maintain function.
related_diseases: May be associated with depression, anxiety, and cognitive decline.

Title: Multiple Sclerosis
Description: Multiple sclerosis (MS) is an autoimmune condition where the immune system attacks the protective covering of nerves, causing communication problems between the brain and body. Management focuses on medications to reduce relapses and symptom-focused therapies.
related_diseases: May be associated with fatigue, depression, and muscle weakness.

Title: Rheumatoid Arthritis
Description: Rheumatoid arthritis is a chronic autoimmune disorder causing inflammation and pain in the joints. Treatment includes medications, physical therapy, and lifestyle modifications to preserve mobility and reduce inflammation.
related_diseases: May be associated with cardiovascular disease, osteoporosis, and depression.

Title: Lupus
Description: Lupus is an autoimmune disease where the immune system attacks healthy tissues, affecting joints, skin, kidneys, and other organs. Management includes medications, lifestyle adjustments, and monitoring organ function to prevent flare-ups.
related_diseases: May be associated with kidney disease, anemia, and cardiovascular disease.

Title: Hemophilia
Description: Hemophilia is a genetic bleeding disorder where blood does not clot properly, leading to prolonged bleeding. Management includes clotting factor replacement, preventive care, and avoiding injuries.
related_diseases: May be associated with joint damage, anemia, and infections from blood products.

Title: Sickle Cell Anemia
Description: Sickle cell anemia is a genetic disorder where red blood cells are abnormally shaped, leading to anemia, pain, and organ damage. Management focuses on medications, blood transfusions, and lifestyle measures to prevent complications.
related_diseases: May be associated with stroke, infections, and pulmonary hypertension.

Title: Thalassemia
Description: Thalassemia is an inherited blood disorder causing reduced hemoglobin production and anemia. Management includes regular blood transfusions, iron chelation therapy, and monitoring for complications.
related_diseases: May be associated with iron overload, bone deformities, and growth delays.

Title: Hemochromatosis
Description: Hemochromatosis is a genetic disorder causing excessive iron accumulation in the body. Management involves phlebotomy, dietary adjustments, and monitoring for organ damage.
related_diseases: May be associated with liver disease, diabetes, and heart disease.

Title: Pancreatitis
Description: Pancreatitis is inflammation of the pancreas that can be acute or chronic, leading to abdominal pain and digestive issues. Management includes dietary modifications, medications, and treating underlying causes.
related_diseases: May be associated with gallstones, alcohol use, and diabetes.

Title: Cirrhosis
Description: Cirrhosis is advanced scarring of the liver caused by chronic liver disease. Management focuses on treating the underlying cause, lifestyle modifications, and monitoring for complications like liver failure.
related_diseases: May be associated with hepatitis, alcohol use, and portal hypertension.

Title: Hepatitis B
Description: Hepatitis B is a viral infection that affects the liver, potentially leading to chronic liver disease and liver cancer. Management includes antiviral medications, monitoring liver function, and vaccination for prevention.
related_diseases: May be associated with cirrhosis, liver failure, and hepatitis D infection.

Title: Hepatitis C
Description: Hepatitis C is a viral infection causing liver inflammation that can progress to chronic liver disease. Management involves antiviral therapy and lifestyle modifications to protect liver health.
related_diseases: May be associated with cirrhosis, liver cancer, and diabetes.

Title: Obstructive Sleep Apnea
Description: Obstructive sleep apnea is a condition where breathing repeatedly stops and starts during sleep due to airway obstruction. Management includes lifestyle changes, CPAP therapy, and sometimes surgery.
related_diseases: May be associated with obesity, hypertension, and cardiovascular disease.

Title: Chronic Fatigue Syndrome
Description: Chronic fatigue syndrome is a complex disorder characterized by extreme fatigue that is not improved by rest. Management includes pacing activity, sleep management, and symptom-focused therapies.
related_diseases: May be associated with fibromyalgia, depression, and anxiety.

Title: Migraine (Diet Focus)
Description: Diet-focused migraine management considers how certain foods and eating patterns trigger or worsen headaches. Strategies include avoiding triggers, maintaining hydration, and nutrient support.
related_diseases: May be associated with anxiety, depression, and hormonal fluctuations.

Title: Eczema (Nutrition Focused)
Description: Nutrition-focused eczema management explores dietary factors that may influence skin inflammation and flare-ups. Approaches include identifying triggers, ensuring adequate essential fatty acids, and supporting gut health.
related_diseases: May be associated with allergies, asthma, and hay fever.

Title: Psoriasis (Nutrition Focused)
Description: Nutrition-focused psoriasis management aims to reduce inflammation and support skin health through diet. Approaches include anti-inflammatory foods, omega-3 supplementation, and weight management.
related_diseases: May be associated with arthritis, metabolic syndrome, and cardiovascular disease.

Title: Macular Degeneration
Description: Macular degeneration is an age-related condition causing loss of central vision due to damage to the retina. Management includes nutrient supplementation, lifestyle modifications, and regular eye monitoring.
related_diseases: May be associated with smoking, cardiovascular disease, and obesity.

Title: Glaucoma (Diet Support)
Description: Glaucoma is a group of eye conditions that damage the optic nerve, often associated with elevated eye pressure. Diet-focused support includes antioxidants, hydration, and nutrients that support eye health.
related_diseases: May be associated with hypertension, diabetes, and age-related eye changes.

Title: Cataracts (Nutrition Focused)
Description: Cataracts are clouding of the eye lens that impairs vision, commonly related to aging. Nutrition-focused management includes antioxidants, vitamin C, and lutein to support lens health.
related_diseases: May be associated with diabetes, smoking, and prolonged UV exposure.

Title: Osteoarthritis
Description: Osteoarthritis is a degenerative joint disease causing cartilage breakdown, pain, and stiffness. Management includes weight management, exercise, physical therapy, and sometimes medications or surgery.
related_diseases: May be associated with obesity, joint injury, and aging.

Title: Chronic Kidney Disease Stage 1
Description: Stage 1 chronic kidney disease indicates mild kidney damage with normal or slightly reduced kidney function. Management includes controlling risk factors, monitoring kidney function, and maintaining a healthy lifestyle.
related_diseases: May be associated with hypertension, diabetes, and heart disease.

Title: Chronic Kidney Disease Stage 2
Description: Stage 2 chronic kidney disease shows mild reduction in kidney function. Management focuses on controlling underlying conditions, diet adjustments, and regular kidney monitoring.
related_diseases: May be associated with hypertension, diabetes, and cardiovascular disease.

Title: Chronic Kidney Disease Stage 5 (Dialysis)
Description: Stage 5 chronic kidney disease on dialysis represents kidney failure requiring dialysis to remove waste and maintain fluid balance. Management includes dialysis, monitoring complications, and controlling contributing conditions.
related_diseases: May be associated with hypertension, diabetes, and cardiovascular disease.

Title: Nonalcoholic Steatohepatitis
Description: Nonalcoholic steatohepatitis (NASH) is liver inflammation and damage caused by fat accumulation, not alcohol. Management includes weight loss, diet modifications, exercise, and controlling metabolic risk factors.
related_diseases: May be associated with obesity, type 2 diabetes, and hyperlipidemia.

Title: Hyperuricemia
Description: Hyperuricemia is an elevated uric acid level in the blood that can lead to gout and kidney stones. Management involves medications, diet adjustments, and monitoring uric acid levels.
related_diseases: May be associated with gout, kidney disease, and hypertension.

Title: GERD
Description: Gastroesophageal reflux disease (GERD) occurs when stomach acid flows back into the esophagus, causing heartburn and irritation. Management includes diet modifications, lifestyle changes, and medications to reduce acid.
related_diseases: May be associated with obesity, hiatal hernia, and asthma.

Title: Diverticulosis
Description: Diverticulosis is the presence of small pouches in the colon wall, often without symptoms. Management focuses on high-fiber diet, hydration, and regular bowel habits to prevent complications.
related_diseases: May be associated with constipation, aging, and low-fiber diet.

Title: Diverticulitis (Acute)
Description: Acute diverticulitis occurs when colon pouches become inflamed or infected, causing abdominal pain and digestive symptoms. Management includes antibiotics, diet modifications, and sometimes surgery.
related_diseases: May be associated with obesity, chronic constipation, and diverticulosis.

Title: Post-Bariatric Surgery
Description: Post-bariatric surgery nutrition focuses on meeting protein, vitamin, and mineral needs while preventing complications. Management includes supplementation, dietary progression, and monitoring for deficiencies.
related_diseases: May be associated with nutrient deficiencies, dumping syndrome, and gastrointestinal symptoms.

Title: Malnutrition (Protein-Energy)
Description: Protein energy malnutrition is a deficiency of calories and protein leading to muscle wasting weakness and impaired immunity. It commonly occurs in chronic illness or severe food insecurity.
related_diseases: May be associated with immune deficiency, anemia, and delayed wound healing.

Title: Type 2 Diabetes
Description: Type 2 diabetes is a chronic metabolic disorder characterized by insulin resistance and elevated blood glucose levels. It develops gradually and is strongly associated with lifestyle and genetic factors.
related_diseases: May be associated with obesity, hypertension, hyperlipidemia, and cardiovascular disease.

Title: Hypertension (DASH Style)
Description: Hypertension managed with a DASH style dietary approach emphasizes reduced sodium and increased intake of fruits vegetables and whole grains. Dietary patterns significantly influence blood pressure control.
related_diseases: May be associated with heart disease, stroke, and chronic kidney disease.

Title: Hyperlipidemia (LDL Reduction)
Description: Hyperlipidemia with LDL reduction focus involves lowering low density lipoprotein cholesterol to reduce plaque buildup in arteries. Diet lifestyle modification and medication may be used.
related_diseases: May be associated with heart disease, metabolic syndrome, and stroke.

Title: Obesity (Calorie Restriction)
Description: Obesity managed through calorie restriction aims to create a sustained energy deficit for gradual weight loss. Long term lifestyle modification supports improved metabolic health.
related_diseases: May be associated with type 2 diabetes, hypertension, and sleep apnea.

Title: Osteopenia
Description: Osteopenia is a condition of lower than normal bone density that precedes osteoporosis. It increases fracture risk if not properly managed.
related_diseases: May be associated with osteoporosis and vitamin D deficiency.

Title: Iron Deficiency
Description: Iron deficiency occurs when the body lacks adequate iron stores even before anemia develops. It may cause fatigue reduced concentration and weakened immunity.
related_diseases: May be associated with iron deficiency anemia and malnutrition.

Title: Constipation (Chronic)
Description: Chronic constipation involves infrequent difficult or incomplete bowel movements lasting several weeks or longer. Diet hydration and physical activity play important roles in management.
related_diseases: May be associated with diverticulosis and irritable bowel syndrome.

Title: Diarrhea
Description: Diarrhea is characterized by frequent loose or watery stools. It may result from infection inflammation or malabsorption.
related_diseases: May be associated with dehydration and electrolyte imbalance.

Title: Chronic Kidney Disease
Description: Chronic kidney disease is a long term decline in kidney function affecting waste removal and fluid balance. It progresses in stages and requires ongoing monitoring.
related_diseases: May be associated with hypertension, diabetes, and anemia.

Title: Heart Disease (Cardiac Rehab)
Description: Heart disease in cardiac rehabilitation focuses on supervised exercise nutrition and lifestyle recovery after cardiac events. Rehabilitation improves cardiovascular outcomes and quality of life.
related_diseases: May be associated with hypertension, hyperlipidemia, and diabetes.

Title: Vitamin D Deficiency
Description: Vitamin D deficiency occurs when levels are insufficient to support bone immune and muscle health. It may result from limited sun exposure or inadequate intake.
related_diseases: May be associated with osteoporosis and immune dysfunction.

Title: Vitamin B12 Deficiency
Description: Vitamin B12 deficiency impairs red blood cell formation and nerve function. It may cause fatigue numbness and cognitive changes.
related_diseases: May be associated with anemia and malabsorption syndrome.

Title: Lactose Intolerance
Description: Lactose intolerance is the inability to properly digest lactose due to low lactase enzyme levels. It causes bloating gas and diarrhea after dairy consumption.
related_diseases: May be associated with irritable bowel syndrome and malabsorption.

Title: Food Allergy
Description: Food allergy is an immune mediated reaction to specific food proteins. Reactions can range from mild symptoms to severe anaphylaxis.
related_diseases: May be associated with asthma, eczema, and allergic rhinitis.

Title: Anorexia Nervosa
Description: Anorexia nervosa is an eating disorder characterized by severe food restriction and intense fear of weight gain. It leads to significant weight loss and nutritional deficiencies.
related_diseases: May be associated with osteoporosis, depression, and electrolyte imbalance.

Title: Bulimia Nervosa
Description: Bulimia nervosa is an eating disorder involving cycles of binge eating followed by purging behaviors. It can disrupt electrolyte balance and digestive health.
related_diseases: May be associated with anxiety, depression, and metabolic alkalosis.

Title: Gallstones
Description: Gallstones are hardened deposits that form in the gallbladder from bile components. They may block bile ducts and cause abdominal pain.
related_diseases: May be associated with cholecystitis and pancreatitis.

Title: Cholecystitis
Description: Cholecystitis is inflammation of the gallbladder often caused by gallstones blocking bile flow. It produces abdominal pain fever and digestive symptoms.
related_diseases: May be associated with gallstones and pancreatitis.

Title: Vitamin A Deficiency
Description: Vitamin A deficiency impairs vision immune response and skin integrity. Severe deficiency can cause night blindness.
related_diseases: May be associated with malnutrition and immune deficiency.

Title: Vitamin C Deficiency
Description: Vitamin C deficiency weakens connective tissue and immune function. Severe cases can result in scurvy.
related_diseases: May be associated with poor wound healing and anemia.

Title: Chronic Bronchitis
Description: Chronic bronchitis is long term inflammation of the bronchial tubes producing excess mucus and persistent cough. It is a form of chronic obstructive lung disease.
related_diseases: May be associated with COPD and emphysema.

Title: Emphysema
Description: Emphysema is a lung condition involving destruction of air sacs that reduces oxygen exchange. It leads to progressive shortness of breath.
related_diseases: May be associated with COPD and chronic bronchitis.

Title: Peripheral Neuropathy
Description: Peripheral neuropathy involves nerve damage causing numbness tingling or pain in the extremities. It commonly results from diabetes injury or nutrient deficiency.
related_diseases: May be associated with diabetes and vitamin B12 deficiency.

Title: Chronic Migraine
Description: Chronic migraine involves headaches occurring fifteen or more days per month. Triggers may include diet stress and hormonal changes.
related_diseases: May be associated with anxiety and sleep disorders.

Title: Insomnia
Description: Insomnia is a sleep disorder characterized by difficulty falling or staying asleep. It affects cognitive emotional and physical health.
related_diseases: May be associated with anxiety, depression, and chronic stress disorder.

Title: Chronic Sinusitis
Description: Chronic sinusitis is long term inflammation of the sinus cavities causing congestion facial pressure and drainage. It may persist for several months.
related_diseases: May be associated with allergies and asthma.

Title: Chronic Stress Disorder
Description: Chronic stress disorder involves prolonged activation of the stress response that impacts overall health. It can disrupt hormonal immune and metabolic balance.
related_diseases: May be associated with anxiety, depression, and hypertension.

Title: Metabolic Acidosis
Description: Metabolic acidosis occurs when excess acid accumulates in the body due to kidney dysfunction or other metabolic causes. It disrupts normal cellular processes.
related_diseases: May be associated with chronic kidney disease and diabetes.

Title: Metabolic Alkalosis
Description: Metabolic alkalosis is a condition in which body fluids become excessively alkaline. It often results from prolonged vomiting or diuretic use.
related_diseases: May be associated with electrolyte imbalance and eating disorders.

Title: Postoperative Recovery
Description: Postoperative recovery involves healing and metabolic adaptation after surgery. Adequate nutrition supports tissue repair immune function and strength restoration.
related_diseases: May be associated with infection risk and malnutrition.

Title: Acute Infection Recovery
Description: Acute infection recovery is the period following an infection when the body restores normal function. Nutritional and immune support are important for healing.
related_diseases: May be associated with dehydration and inflammation.

Title: Chronic Pain Syndrome
Description: Chronic pain syndrome is persistent pain lasting longer than three months. It affects physical function and psychological well being.
related_diseases: May be associated with depression, anxiety, and fibromyalgia.

Title: Fibromyalgia
Description: Fibromyalgia is a chronic condition characterized by widespread musculoskeletal pain fatigue and sleep disturbance. It often includes cognitive symptoms.
related_diseases: May be associated with chronic fatigue syndrome and depression.

Title: Chronic Dehydration
Description: Chronic dehydration occurs when fluid intake consistently fails to meet bodily needs. It affects kidney function circulation and temperature regulation.
related_diseases: May be associated with kidney disease and electrolyte imbalance.

Title: Electrolyte Imbalance
Description: Electrolyte imbalance involves abnormal levels of minerals such as sodium potassium or calcium. It can disrupt heart nerve and muscle function.
related_diseases: May be associated with dehydration and kidney disease.

Title: Chronic Inflammation
Description: Chronic inflammation is a prolonged immune response that can damage tissues over time. It plays a role in many metabolic and degenerative diseases.
related_diseases: May be associated with heart disease, diabetes, and autoimmune disorders.

Title: Immune Deficiency
Description: Immune deficiency is reduced ability of the immune system to fight infections effectively. It may be inherited or acquired.
related_diseases: May be associated with chronic infections and malnutrition.

Title: Chronic Viral Infection
Description: Chronic viral infection occurs when a virus persists in the body over an extended period. It may cause ongoing inflammation and organ damage.
related_diseases: May be associated with immune deficiency and liver disease.

Title: Chronic Bacterial Infection
Description: Chronic bacterial infection occurs when bacteria persist in the body over time, causing ongoing symptoms and tissue damage. Management includes targeted antibiotics, monitoring for complications, and addressing underlying risk factors.
related_diseases: May be associated with immune suppression, chronic inflammation, and organ-specific damage.

Title: General Malabsorption Syndrome
Description: General malabsorption syndrome is a condition where the intestines cannot properly absorb nutrients from food. Management includes identifying the underlying cause, dietary adjustments, and supplementation of deficient nutrients.
related_diseases: May be associated with celiac disease, chronic pancreatitis, and inflammatory bowel disease.

Title: Peanut Allergy
Description: Peanut allergy is an immune system reaction to proteins found in peanuts. It can cause symptoms ranging from hives and swelling to severe anaphylaxis.
related_diseases: May be associated with other food allergies, asthma, and eczema.

Title: Nut Allergy
Description: Nut allergy is an allergic reaction to tree nuts such as almonds walnuts or cashews. Reactions can vary from mild itching to life threatening anaphylaxis.
related_diseases: May be associated with peanut allergy, asthma, and allergic rhinitis.

Title: Milk Allergy
Description: Milk allergy is an immune response to proteins found in cow milk. It differs from lactose intolerance and can cause skin respiratory or gastrointestinal symptoms.
related_diseases: May be associated with eczema, asthma, and other food allergies.

Title: Egg Allergy
Description: Egg allergy is an immune reaction to proteins in egg whites or yolks. It is common in children and may be outgrown over time.
related_diseases: May be associated with other food allergies, eczema, and asthma.

Title: Soy Allergy
Description: Soy allergy is an immune response to soy proteins found in many processed foods. Symptoms may affect the skin digestive tract or respiratory system.
related_diseases: May be associated with peanut allergy and other legume allergies.

Title: Wheat Allergy
Description: Wheat allergy is an immune reaction to proteins found in wheat. It is distinct from celiac disease and gluten intolerance.
related_diseases: May be associated with other food allergies, asthma, and eczema.

Title: Shellfish Allergy
Description: Shellfish allergy is an immune response to proteins in crustaceans or mollusks. It is one of the most common adult food allergies and can be severe.
related_diseases: May be associated with fish allergy and other food allergies.

Title: Fish Allergy
Description: Fish allergy is an immune reaction to proteins in finned fish. Even small exposures can trigger significant allergic responses.
related_diseases: May be associated with shellfish allergy and other food allergies.

Title: Sesame Allergy
Description: Sesame allergy is an immune response to sesame seeds or sesame oil. It can cause skin respiratory or systemic reactions.
related_diseases: May be associated with other seed and nut allergies.

Title: Corn Allergy
Description: Corn allergy is an immune reaction to proteins in corn or corn derived products. Symptoms may include digestive or skin reactions.
related_diseases: May be associated with other grain allergies and food sensitivities.

Title: Chocolate Allergy
Description: Chocolate allergy is a rare immune reaction often related to cocoa or added ingredients such as milk or nuts. Symptoms may involve skin respiratory or digestive reactions.
related_diseases: May be associated with milk allergy, nut allergy, and soy allergy.

Title: Strawberry Allergy
Description: Strawberry allergy is an immune response to proteins in strawberries. It may cause itching swelling or hives.
related_diseases: May be associated with other fruit allergies and oral allergy syndrome.

Title: Tomato Allergy
Description: Tomato allergy is an immune reaction to proteins in tomatoes. Symptoms may include skin rashes itching or digestive upset.
related_diseases: May be associated with pollen allergy and oral allergy syndrome.

Title: Garlic Allergy
Description: Garlic allergy is an immune response to compounds found in garlic. It may cause skin respiratory or gastrointestinal symptoms.
related_diseases: May be associated with onion allergy and other spice allergies.

Title: Mustard Allergy
Description: Mustard allergy is an immune reaction to mustard seeds or mustard containing foods. It can cause hives swelling or breathing difficulty.
related_diseases: May be associated with other seed allergies and food allergies.

Title: Sunflower Seed Allergy
Description: Sunflower seed allergy is an immune response to proteins in sunflower seeds. Reactions may range from mild itching to severe systemic symptoms.
related_diseases: May be associated with sesame allergy and other seed allergies.

Title: Oysters Allergy
Description: Oysters allergy is an immune reaction to proteins in oysters. Symptoms may include hives, digestive upset, or anaphylaxis.
related_diseases: May be associated with shellfish allergy, fish allergy, and other crustacean allergies.

Title: Shrimp Allergy
Description: Shrimp allergy is an immune response to proteins found in shrimp. It can trigger mild to severe allergic reactions.
related_diseases: May be associated with shellfish allergy, crab allergy, and other crustacean allergies.

Title: Crab Allergy
Description: Crab allergy is an immune reaction to proteins in crab. Symptoms may include hives, swelling, gastrointestinal upset, or anaphylaxis.
related_diseases: May be associated with shrimp allergy, lobster allergy, and other shellfish allergies.

Title: Lobster Allergy
Description: Lobster allergy is an immune response to proteins in lobster. Reactions can range from mild skin irritation to severe anaphylaxis.
related_diseases: May be associated with other crustacean allergies and shellfish allergy.

Title: Scallops Allergy
Description: Scallops allergy is an immune reaction to proteins in scallops. Symptoms may involve the skin, gastrointestinal tract, or respiratory system.
related_diseases: May be associated with shellfish allergy and other mollusk allergies.

Title: Kiwi Allergy

Title: Avocado Allergy

related_diseases: May be associated with latex allergy and other fruit allergies.

Title: Mango Allergy

Title: Peach Allergy
Description: Peach allergy is an immune response to peach proteins. Symptoms may include oral itching, swelling, and skin reactions.
related_diseases: May be associated with other stone fruit allergies and pollen allergy.

Title: Apple Allergy
Description: Apple allergy is an immune reaction to proteins in apples. It often causes oral allergy syndrome with itching or swelling in the mouth and throat.
related_diseases: May be associated with birch pollen allergy and other fruit allergies.

Title: Banana Allergy
Description: Banana allergy is an immune response to proteins in bananas. Symptoms may include oral itching, swelling, or digestive upset.
related_diseases: May be associated with latex allergy and other tropical fruit allergies.

Title: Blueberry Allergy
Description: Blueberry allergy is an immune reaction to proteins in blueberries. Symptoms may include hives, itching, or gastrointestinal upset.
related_diseases: May be associated with other berry allergies and pollen allergy.

Title: Raspberry Allergy
